subject: Interest from Cloud Marketplace listing — Quick intro & demo?
messages:
From: Jordan Weber <jordan@acmeanalytics.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interest from Cloud Marketplace listing — Quick intro & demo?

Hi Ben,

Saw Redwood on the Cloud Marketplace and it looks like a good fit for a project we're kicking off. We're evaluating inference platforms to replace some of our ad-hoc self-hosted endpoints — primary goals are predictable latency, multi-region routing, and tighter cost controls.

Would love a 30-minute intro/demo next week to see the product and ask a few integration questions (KV cache behavior, rollout policies, and any marketplace-specific billing details).

A quick bit about us: Acme Analytics runs a realtime recommendations pipeline at ~15k TPS peak, experimenting with caching layers and model quantization. We're exploring both hosted and dedicated options depending on compliance constraints.

If you can share 2-3 slots that work, I can coordinate with our platform lead. Also attaching our short security checklist for context.

Thanks,
Jordan Weber
Director, Data Platform
Acme Analytics
jordan@acmeanalytics.com
(415) 555-0198

Hi Jordan — great to hear from you and thanks for the context. Really appreciate you attaching the security checklist; that's helpful.

We'd be happy to run a 30-minute intro and product demo focused on integration patterns and deployment options (hosted vs Dedicated). I have the following windows next week:
- Tue 7/6: 9:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 7/7: 10:00-12:00 PT
- Thu 7/8: 14:00-16:00 PT

If none of those work, you can grab a time on my calendar here: https://calendly.com/ben-redwood/30min

Ahead of the call: could you confirm whether you expect the workload to be single-tenant (dedicated GPUs) vs multi-tenant hosted? Knowing that helps us tailor the demo and who joins from our side.

I've attached our product one-pager for reference. Marissa (cc'd) will help coordinate the invite.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
